title: ForceResourcePack
description: Force player to download your resource pack if they don't they get kicked
body:
players have to accept the resource pack if they don't they get kicked...

# **Features**
> ✅ Forces resource pack

# **Config**
```
# Go to https://mc-packs.net/ and upload your pack you should get a "sha1" and a resource pack link paste them into the corresponding place

url: ""
sha1: ""

# messages below (Don't need to edit this if you don't want too!)

accepted: "Resource pack loaded!"                     # Loaded / Accepted
declined: "Resource pack declined!"                   # Failed / Declined
```
